# Get-ZbxAutoregistration

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the server's autoregistration settings.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxAutoregistration [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxAutoregistration cmdlet reads the server's autoregistration settings with autoregistration.get: which connections an active agent may autoregister over, unencrypted, with a pre-shared key or both. The PSK itself is never returned. It writes one ZabbixAutoregistrationSettings object and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer as a Super admin.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read which connections may autoregister

```powershell
Get-ZbxAutoregistration
```

TlsAccept is a set of flags: Unencrypted, Psk, or both.

### Example 2: Check whether unencrypted agents may autoregister

```powershell
[bool]((Get-ZbxAutoregistration).TlsAccept -band [Community.Zabbix.ZabbixTlsAcceptModes]::Unencrypted)
```

-band tests one flag of the set.

## PARAMETERS

### -Connection

The server to talk to: a connection name from Get-ZbxContext, or the connection object. The current server when omitted.
